30795-the-song-of-hiawatha-an-epic-poem.title: An Epic Poem
30795-the-song-of-hiawatha-an-epic-poem.creator: Henry Wadsworth Longfellow
30795-the-song-of-hiawatha-an-epic-poem.description: A book by Henry Wadsworth Longfellow. tely be named the "Kalevala" of North America. Longfellow derived his knowledge of Indian legends from Schoolcraft's Algic Researches and other books, from Heckewelder's Narratives, from Black Hawk, with his display of Sacs and Foxes on Boston Common, and from the Ojibway chief, Kahge-gagah-bowh, whom he entertained at his own home.

arxiv-2104-05837.title: Relational World Knowledge Representation in Contextual Language Models: A Review
arxiv-2104-05837.creator: Tara Safavi, Danai Koutra
arxiv-2104-05837.description: Abstract Relational knowledge bases (KBs) are commonly used to represent world knowledge in machines. However, while advantageous for their high degree of precision and interpretability, KBs are usually organized according to manually-defined schemas, which limit their expressiveness and require significant human efforts to engineer and maintain.

arxiv-2203-09055.title: Fine- and Coarse-Granularity Hybrid Self-Attention for Efficient BERT
arxiv-2203-09055.creator: Jing Zhao, Yifan Wang, Junwei Bao, Youzheng Wu, Xiaodong He
arxiv-2203-09055.description: Abstract Transformer-based pre-trained models, such as BERT, have shown extraordinary success in achieving state-of-the-art results in many natural language processing applications. However, deploying these models can be prohibitively costly, as the standard self-attention mechanism of the Transformer suffers from quadratic computational cost in the input sequence length.

arxiv-2211-04776.title: Regularized Rényi divergence minimization through Bregman proximal gradient algorithms
arxiv-2211-04776.creator: Thomas Guilmeau, Emilie Chouzenoux, Víctor Elvira
arxiv-2211-04776.description: Abstract We study the variational inference problem of minimizing a regularized Rényi divergence over an exponential family. We propose to solve this problem with a Bregman proximal gradient algorithm. We propose a sampling-based algorithm to cover the black-box setting, corresponding to a stochastic Bregman proximal gradient algorithm with biased gradient estimator.

arxiv-2302-08980.title: Model Doctor for Diagnosing and Treating Segmentation Error
arxiv-2302-08980.creator: Zhijie Jia, Lin Chen, Kaiwen Hu, Lechao Cheng \sthanks Corresponding author, Zunlei Feng, Mingli Song
arxiv-2302-08980.description: Abstract Despite the remarkable progress in semantic segmentation tasks with the advancement of deep neural networks, existing U-shaped hierarchical typical segmentation networks still suffer from local misclassification of categories and inaccurate target boundaries. In an effort to alleviate this issue, we propose a Model Doctor for semantic segmentation problems.

arxiv-2302-09936.title: Optimizing the magnon-phonon cooperativity in planar geometries
arxiv-2302-09936.creator: K. An, C. Kim, K.-W. Moon, R. Kohno, G. Olivetti, G. de Loubens, N. Vukadinovic, J. Ben Youssef, C. Hwang, O. Klein
arxiv-2302-09936.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by K. An, C. Kim, K.-W. Moon, R. Kohno, G. Olivetti, G. de Loubens, N. Vukadinovic, J. Ben Youssef, C. Hwang, O. Klein. Optimizing the cooperativity between two distinct particles is an important feature of quantum information processing. Of particular interest is the coupling between spin and phonon, which allows for integrated long range communication between gates operating at GHz frequency.

arxiv-2308-05295.title: Multimodal Pretrained Models for Verifiable Sequential Decision-Making: Planning, Grounding, and Perception Conference: Proc. of the 23rd International Conference on Autonomous Agents and Multiagent Systems (AAMAS 2024); May 6 – 10, 2024; Auckland, New Zealand 100
arxiv-2308-05295.creator: Yunhao Yang, Cyrus Neary, Ufuk Topcu
arxiv-2308-05295.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Yunhao Yang, Cyrus Neary, Ufuk Topcu. Recently developed pretrained models can encode rich world knowledge expressed in multiple modalities, such as text and images. However, the outputs of these models cannot be integrated into algorithms to solve sequential decision-making tasks. We develop an algorithm that utilizes the knowledge from pretrained models to construct and verify controllers for sequential decision-making tasks, and to ground these controllers to task environments through visual observations with formal guarantees.

arxiv-2406-17994.title: Computing linear optical spectra in the presence of nonadiabatic effects on Graphics Processing Units using molecular dynamics and tensor-network approaches
arxiv-2406-17994.creator: Evan Lambertson, Dayana Bashirova, Kye E. Hunter, Benhardt Hansen, Tim J. Zuehlsdorff
arxiv-2406-17994.description: Abstract We compare two recently developed strategies, implemented in open source software packages, for computing linear optical spectra in condensed phase environments in the presence of nonadiabatic effects. Both approaches rely on computing excitation energy and transition dipole fluctuations along molecular dynamics (MD) trajectories, treating molecular and environmental degrees of freedom on the same footing.

arxiv-2407-17519.title: Universal methods for variational inequalities: deterministic and stochastic cases
arxiv-2407-17519.creator: Anton Klimza, Alexander Gasnikov, Fedor Stonyakin, Mohammad Alkousa
arxiv-2407-17519.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Anton Klimza, Alexander Gasnikov, Fedor Stonyakin, Mohammad Alkousa. In this paper, we propose universal proximal mirror methods to solve the variational inequality problem with Hölder-continuous operators in both deterministic and stochastic settings. The proposed methods automatically adapt not only to the oracle’s noise (in the stochastic setting of the problem) but also to the Hölder continuity of the operator without having prior knowledge of either the problem class or the nature of the operator information.

arxiv-2501-10180.title: Three-dimensional deformations in single-layer α \alpha antimonene and interaction with a Au(111) surface from first principles
arxiv-2501-10180.creator: José de Jesús Villalobos Castro, Thomas Pierron, Stephane Pons, Johann Coraux, Lorenzo Sponza, Sergio Vlaic
arxiv-2501-10180.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by José de Jesús Villalobos Castro, Thomas Pierron, Stephane Pons, Johann Coraux, Lorenzo Sponza, Sergio Vlaic. Using density functional theory, we investigate the electronic structure of the α \alpha phase of an antimony monolayer ( α \alpha -Sb) in its isolated form and in contact to the (111) surface of gold. We demonstrate that the isolated α \alpha -Sb single-layer actually displays a slightly modulated puckering that stabilizes the monolayer, not a uniform one as often assumed.

arxiv-2502-19117.title: Numerical Ergodicity and Optimal Strong Error Estimates for a Class of Novel Tamed Schemes to Superlinear SPDEs
arxiv-2502-19117.creator: Zhihui LIU, Jie SHEN
arxiv-2502-19117.description: Abstract . We construct a class of novel tamed schemes for superlinear stochastic partial differential equations (SPDEs), including the stochastic Allen–Cahn equation driven by either multiplicative or additive noise. The schemes preserve the same Lyapunov structure as the original system, and we rigorously establish their longtime unconditional stability.

arxiv-2508-17108.title: Exploring AI-Enabled Test Practice, Affect, and Test Outcomes in Language Assessment
arxiv-2508-17108.creator: Jill Burstein
arxiv-2508-17108.description: Abstract Practice tests for high-stakes assessment are intended to build test familiarity, and reduce construct-irrelevant variance which can interfere with valid score interpretation. Generative AI-driven, automated item generation (AIG) scales the creation of large item banks and multiple practice tests, enabling repeated practice opportunities.

pmc-10563286.title: Psychometric properties of persian version of escapism scale among Iranian adolescents
pmc-10563286.creator: Roghieh Nooripour, Nikzad Ghanbari, Simin Hosseinian, Carl J. Lavie, Nazir Mozaffari, Sverker Sikström, Seyed Ruhollah Hosseini
pmc-10563286.description: The aim of this study was to assess the psychometric properties of the Persian version of the Escapism Scale among Iranian adolescents aged 14–18. Between January 2021 and August 2021, cross-sectional study was conducted using a convenience sampling method to select 566 participants (340 girls and 226 boys) to investigate the relationship between physical activity and mental health in adolescents.

pmc-11345898.title: A rare vision: First reported case of bilateral uveal metastasis from prostate cancer in the Middle East
pmc-11345898.creator: Ernest Diab, Lynn Abi Khalil, Georges Baaklini, Antoine Chartouni, Joseph Kattan
pmc-11345898.description: We present the first reported case in the Middle East of bilateral uveal metastasis from prostate cancer in a 74-year-old man. Initially diagnosed in November 2016 with high-volume metastatic castrate-sensitive prostate cancer (mCSPC), his cancer progressed and was castrate-resistant. In December 2022, the patient presented blurry vision in the left eye and was diagnosed with left uveal metastase.

pmc-11451469.title: Evaluating the Efficacy of Conbercept and Dexamethasone Implants Sequentially in the Treatment of Refractory Macular Edema Secondary to Central Retinal Vein Occlusion (CRVO): A One-Year Follow-Up Study
pmc-11451469.creator: Peiyu Xing, Yucheng Zhang, Yong Zhang, Shaowei Wang, Xiaojia Hu, Meihua Wang, Fan Xia, Yang Zhao, Wei Qu, Bo Meng
pmc-11451469.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). PurposeThe objective of this research was to assess the effectiveness and safety of using Conbercept injection and dexamethasone implant (DEX I) in sequence for treating refractory macular edema (ME) caused by central retinal vein occlusion (CRVO) in patients.MethodsA study was conducted on 34 patients with persistent macular edema caused by central retinal vein occlusion, reviewing their medical history and interventions performed. Sequential implantation of DEX I was performed 1 week after the Conbercept injection.

pmc-11673193.title: GeniePool 2.0: advancing variant analysis through CHM13-T2T, AlphaMissense, gnomAD V4 integration, and variant co-occurrence queries
pmc-11673193.creator: Grisha Weintraub, Noam Hadar, Ehud Gudes, Shlomi Dolev, Ohad S Birk
pmc-11673193.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Originally developed to meet the challenges of genomic data deluge, GeniePool emerged as a pioneering platform, enabling efficient storage, accessibility, and analysis of vast genomic datasets, enabled due to its data lake architecture. Building on this foundation, GeniePool 2.0 advances genomic analysis through the integration of cutting-edge variant databases, such as CHM13-T2T, AlphaMissense, and gnomAD V4, coupled with the capability for variant co-occurrence queries.

pmc-12467333.title: Tolerability and Shared Decision-Making in the Hormonal Management of Endometriosis-Associated Pain
pmc-12467333.creator: Diogo Pinto da Costa Viana, Leonardo Jacobsen, Igor Padovesi, Ana Comin, Eline Lobo de Souza Correia, Daniela Da Maia Fernandes, Ana Carolina Pires Dias, Chi Chiu Wang, Nikolaos Machairiotis
pmc-12467333.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background: The management of endometriosis-associated pain has traditionally focused on analgesic efficacy. However, with high-level evidence demonstrating therapeutic equivalence among principal hormonal classes, the paradigm has shifted towards a patient-centred approach prioritising long-term tolerability and shared decision-making. Objectives: This review critically synthesises the evidence for the three main hormonal therapies—gonadotropin-releasing hormone (GnRH) analogues, dienogest, and gestrinone—focusing on their distinct tolerability and safety profiles to inform this modern clinical framework.

pmc-12751481.title: Tagatose consumption provokes metabolic syndrome features in rat males from mothers that consumed fructose during their pregnancy
pmc-12751481.creator: Elena Fauste, Madelín Pérez-Armas, Cristina Donis, Paola Otero, Mª Isabel Panadero, Carlos Bocos
pmc-12751481.description: BackgroundMaternal fructose intake induces harmful effects in progeny. However, this sugar is not contraindicated during pregnancy. On the other hand, the use of low-calorie sweeteners, such as tagatose, is increasing. Thus, we have studied whether the consumption of tagatose compared to fructose affects lipid metabolism in the offspring of mothers which were supplemented with fructose during their pregnancy.

pmc-13206977.title: Morphological Diversity as a Proxy for Assessing Genetic Diversity of Aedes aegypti (Diptera, Culicidae)
pmc-13206977.creator: Fernanda Almeida Lopes, Camila Moratore, Karina Ramos dos Santos, Lucas Fujimori Tani, Marília Lara Peixoto, Lincoln Suesdek
pmc-13206977.description: Highlights Morphological diversity of wings is higher in wild than in colonised Aedes aegyptiColonisation diminishes morphological diversity in Ae. aegyptiMorphological diversity partly corresponds to genetic variability in Ae. aegyptiWing shape diversity may be used as a proxy to estimate genetic variability Simple SummaryAedes aegypti mosquito poses a significant global health threat by spreading viruses to millions of people each year.

pmc-13332902.title: Tight contact structures on a family of hyperbolic L-spaces
pmc-13332902.creator: Hyunki Min, Isacco Nonino
pmc-13332902.description: We classify tight contact structures on various surgeries on the Whitehead link, which provides the first classification result on an infinite family of hyperbolic L-spaces. We also determine which of the tight contact structures are Stein fillable and which are virtually overtwisted.

pmc-13653588.title: Anchored Oxygen‐Release‐Suppression Phase Stabilizing High‐Voltage Ni‐Rich Cathode Materials
pmc-13653588.creator: Ziqi Liu, Yiming Zhang, Yong Chen, Meng Yao, Yangyang Wang, Du Yuan, Haitao Zhang, Yun Zhang, Guoxiu Wang
pmc-13653588.description: The Ni‐rich LiNixCoyMn1−x−yO2 (x ≥ 0.9) cathode materials (NCMs) have been considered promising for next‐generation Li‐ion batteries owing to their high‐energy density. However, their practical application is hindered by gas evolution and rapid capacity degradation, primarily caused by irreversible oxygen release and structural instability.
